subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retire the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow, or keep/replace the post-publish release repair path before this PR lands?
rationale: The PR changes release recovery policy, and source inspection shows the remaining npm release workflow is not an equivalent path once npm has already accepted the package.

options.title: Replace repair path before deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair workflow or mode, then update `specs/deploy.md` and release workflow tests to match it.

options.title: Keep the existing workflow
options.body: Leave `clawhub-cli-github-release.yml` and its runbook section in place until release owners choose a different recovery model.

options.title: Retire with owner acceptance
options.body: Release/security automation owners can accept the operational tradeoff if they document how to recover a failed GitHub Release after npm publish.

recommendation.title: Replace repair path before deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair workflow or mode, then update `specs/deploy.md` and release workflow tests to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is tied to the current release automation history, the deploy runbook ownership, and this proposed retirement branch.
